verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim durable execution: 'Interrupted runs resume from their last checkpoint instead of starting over,' which directly supports surviving worker/platform restarts without losing state. However there is no explicit mention of multi-day waits/delays specifically, no independent/hands-on verification of restart durability, and one community report notes bugs in local setup that raise reliability questions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of long-duration (multi-day) wait/delay steps surviving restarts, independent or hands-on confirmation of durable execution under real restarts, and details on state persistence mechanics.
